mentions.name: Isles
mentions.description: An experimental message board / social game where new members are randomly assigned to a small island and can only interact with the people on that island. Islands occasionally link up, letting members explore and migrate between them, as an experiment in small-scale cultural exchange. Built with sprites, Cloudflare Workers, SQLite, Litestream, and React SSR.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tiny experimental message board / ...game? called Isles (https://isles.app/about). The short pitch is that when you sign up you're randomly assigned to a small island, and you can only interact with people on that island. Randomly, islands link up and you can migrate/explore the other island. I wanted to play with ideas of cultural exchange on a really small scale.
